svg.text: a fact until it can subtract.
One 4×4 memory, two write rules. A runbook says “max_batch is 8”, then
pure Python, 4×4, no GPU — reproduces in two seconds
a value that was never configured
THE SAME FACT, WRITTEN FIVE TIMES
the value never changes, so nothing should be written
Capacity is not the constraint. The write policy is.
Ankit CPU run, pure Python · d_k = d_v = 4, β = 1, unit-norm key · numbers
